name: CITY COUNCIL MEETING
agenda_text:
CITY COUNCIL MEETING
AGENDA FOR LA MIRADA CITY COUNCIL MEETING
September 9, 2025 –
6:30
p.m.
COUNCIL CHAMBERS, CITY HALL, 13700 LA MIRADA BOULEVARD,
LA MIRADA, CALIFORNIA 90638
In-Person Public Participation Information
To address the City Council on an Agenda item other than a Public Hearing or during Public
Comments, please fill out a "Request to Address Council" card located in the back of the Council
Chambers near the agendas and submit to the City Clerk prior to the meeting or as soon as
possible. There is a five minute maximum time limit when addressing the City Council. The amount
of time for public comment may be reduced by the Mayor or by action of the City Council
Electronic Public Participation
To submit your Public Comments electronically in advance, please email your written comments to
cityclerk@lamirada.gov. The deadline to submit your Public Comment electronically is on the day
of a regular City Council meeting before 3 p.m. For special meetings, comments must be received
at least three hours prior to the meeting.
Members of the public may participate in this meeting via remote attendance by using the Zoom
Webinar information.
Zoom Meeting Details: www.zoom.us/join
Meeting ID: 897 8121 0338 Telephone Option: 1-669-444-9171
(*6 to unmute; *9 to raise hand)
Public Comment will begin with speakers attending in-person first followed by those attending via
Zoom Webinar.
Reasonable Accommodations
In compliance with the Americans with Disabilities Act, if you need special assistance to participate
in a City Council meeting or other service offered by the City, contact the City Clerk's Office at
(562) 943-0131. Notification at least 48 hours prior to the meeting or time when services are
needed will assist City staff in assuring that reasonable arrangements can be made to provide
accessibility to the meeting or service.
Agenda Materials
Copies of staff reports and supporting documentation pertaining to agenda items are available for
public viewing and inspection at City Hall during regular business hours and on the City's website
http://www.lamirada.gov. For further information regarding agenda items, please contact the
City Clerk's office at (562) 943-0131.
1.
CALL TO ORDER
2.
INVOCATION: Pastor Steve Camarillo, Living Faith Assembly of God Church
3.
PLEDGE OF ALLEGIANCE: Love La Mirada
4.
ROLL CALL:
Councilmember Bean
Councilmember De Ruse
Councilmember Lewis
Mayor Pro Tem Otero
Mayor Eng
5.
APPEARANCES, PRESENTATIONS, AND PROCLAMATIONS
5.1
PROCLAMATION FOR RELAY FOR LIFE MONTH – It is recommended the City Council proclaim September 2025 as Relay for Life Month in the City of La Mirada and present a proclamation to Kate Abad.
5.1 Proclamation for Relay for Life
5.2
PROCLAMATION FOR NATIONAL HISPANIC HERITAGE MONTH – It is recommended the City Council proclaim September 15 through October 15, 2025 as National Hispanic Heritage Month in the City of La Mirada and present a proclamation to Frank Garza.
5.2 Proclamation for Hispanic Heritage Month
6.
PUBLIC COMMENT: (Any information or materials provided during Public Comments are recorded in the minutes and are subject to public disclosure under the Public Records Act. The speaker is requested, but is not required, to orally state his or her name and/or address for purposes of recording the information accurately in the minutes. If the speaker declines to provide his or her name, address, and other relevant information, the records will so indicate. There is a five minute maximum time limit when addressing the City Council.)
7.
APPOINTMENTS
7.1
REAPPOINTMENT TO THE HISTORICAL PRESERVATION ADVISORY COUNCIL – It is recommended the City Council reappoint Rosalie Williams to the Historical Preservation Advisory Council for a term ending in June 2027.
7.1 Reappointment to HPAC
8.
CONSENT CALENDAR: (All items listed on the Consent Calendar are considered to be routine matters, status reports or subjects covered previously by the City Council. Items listed on the Consent Calendar may be enacted in one motion.)
8.1
APPROVAL OF MEETING MINUTES - It is recommended the City Council approve the minutes of the regular meeting of August 26, 2025.
8.1 Minutes - City Council
8.2
APPROVAL OF WARRANT REGISTER - It is recommended the City Council approve the warrant register dated September 9, 2025 in the total amount of $1,669,461.84.
8.2 Warrant Register
8.3
APPROVAL OF THE LOS ANGELES COUNTY SHERIFF’S DEPARTMENT FUNDRAISING EVENT IN THE LA MIRADA CIVIC CENTER PARKING LOT – It is recommended the City Council approve the use of the La Mirada Civic Center parking lot for the Los Angeles County Sheriff’s Department to host a fundraiser car show; and waive all fees associated with the requested use.
8.3 Approval of Facility Use
8.4
FURNISH, INSTALL, REMOVE AND MAINTAIN HOLIDAY DECORATIONS AND LIGHTS – REVIEW AND APPROVAL OF AMENDMENT NO. 3 TO THE SERVICES AGREEMENT WITH THE CHRISTMAS LIGHT GUY COMPANY – It is recommended that the City Council approve and authorize the City Manager to execute Amendment No. 3 to the Services Agreement with The Christmas Light Guy Company in the amount of $62,310.39.
8.4 Review and Approval of Amendment No. 3 - The Christmas Light Guy
8.5
CITY COUNCIL REQUEST FOR CONFERENCE ATTENDANCE - It is recommended the City Council approve Councilmember Bean’s request to attend the 2025 League of California Cities Annual Conference and Expo.
8.5 CIty Council Attendance Request
8.6
EXTENSION OF SOFTWARE LICENSE SUBSCRIPTION WITH CIVICPLUS FOR RECREATION ACTIVITY MANAGEMENT – It is recommended the City Council approve the license subscription with CivicPlus for its CivicRec recreation activity management software for 2026 in the amount of $60,063.18 and two one-year license subscription renewals at the rate mutually agreed upon by City staff and CivicPlus.
8.6 CivicRec Subscription Renewal
8.7
AGREEMENT WITH CYBEREASON FOR CYBERSECURITY SERVICES – It is recommended the City Council approve an agreement with Cybereason for cybersecurity services in the amount of $60,000 and authorize the City Manager to execute the agreement on behalf of the City.
8.7 Agreement with Cybereason for Cybersecurity Services
9.
ORDINANCES AND RESOLUTIONS
9.1
RESOLUTION NO. 25-19 WAIVING THE FORMAL BID PROCESS AND AUTHORIZING THE PURCHASE OF ONE RIZON BOX TRUCK - It is recommended that the City Council adopt Resolution No. 25-19 waiving the formal bid process and authorizing the purchase of one Rizon Box Truck.
9.1 Resolution No. 25-19 Waiving the Formal Bid Process
10.
CITY COUNCIL REPORTS AND ANNOUNCEMENTS
11.
CITY ATTORNEY ANNOUNCEMENTS
12.
CITY MANAGER ANNOUNCEMENTS
13.
ADJOURNMENT
Adjourned Its Regular Meeting In Memory of John Ojeisekhoba.
I hereby certify, under penalty of perjury under the laws of the State of California that the foregoing agenda was posted on the City Hall bulletin board not less than 72 hours prior to the meeting.
____________________________________
Leticia Revilla, City Clerk
